summary.text: Drew Hansen, a Democrat from Bainbridge Island, was appointed to the Washington State Senate for the 23rd Legislative District in 2023. His official biography says he had served in the state House of Representatives since 2011 and sits on the Higher Education & Workforce Development (Vice Chair), Early Learning & K-12 Education, and Ways & Means committees.

paragraphs.text: Hansen's official biography says he focused in Kitsap County on helping people get trained for good jobs, including through partnerships with Olympic College, Western Washington University and apprenticeship programs.
It says that in the House he chaired the Civil Rights & Judiciary Committee from 2020 and, before that, the Higher Education Committee from 2014 to 2020.

The page lists legislation he sponsored or led, including the Shield Law (HB 1469) protecting those who pursue or provide legal reproductive care, Washington's free college tuition law, a state-level net neutrality law, the New Hope Act, the DREAM Act 2.0 and the Public Broadband Act.
